payload.comment: Configuration replay is internally consistent and clean. Key verification points: (1) Model family is ResNet18 with hidden=48 controlling base width; depth=3 and all transformer-specific fields (num_heads, mlp_ratio, patch_size, pooling, positional_encoding, tokenizer_layers) are present but correctly inactive for a CNN family per fixed-topology rules. (2) All 11 data-integrity checks pass; train/val/test sizes (89996/10004/7180) match the official MedMNIST PathMNIST 28×28 RGB distribution exactly; zero overlap; test metrics unused (test_metrics_used=false confirmed in three artefacts). (3) Augmentations (hflip, rotate180, brightness) are all built-in primitives requiring no extension approval; augmentation_factor=4 yields 359984 augmented samples, arithmetically consistent. (4) Per-channel standardization uses train-only statistics with correct H&E channel asymmetry (green std 0.177 vs red/blue ~0.124). (5) Class weighting enabled for the 1.63:1 imbalance; label smoothing 0.1; cosine LR schedule with AdamW at lr=1e-3 — all reasonable for ResNet18 at this scale. (6) Selection rule explicitly excludes test-dependent adaptation; frozen and replayed. (7) No deterministic findings. Minor non-blocking notes carried from upstream: llm_model_digest null for qwen3.8 (reproducibility pinning), stride inconsistency between idea and proposal (irrelevant since selected model is ResNet18, not a transformer). None of these affect the validity of the replayed configuration. Proceed to training.
